text:
The response provides a basic list but suffers from significant shortcomings. It contains a factually incorrect statement about gender roles (women are not traditionally expected to lead meetings in Japan), repeats points (meeting language appears twice), and lacks depth on critical cultural nuances like business card exchange rituals (meishi koukan), consensus-building (nemawashi), hierarchy/seating protocols, gift-giving customs (omiyage), and after-hours relationship building (nomikai). Many points are vague tautologies (e.g., "meetings discuss business") rather than actionable guidance. While it covers a few surface-level norms, the inaccuracy and omission of key cultural practices make it poorly suited for someone genuinely preparing for Japanese business interactions.

Rating: [[3]]
